lines.t: You think the fight is in desires, in the pull you feel inside
But the real temptation whispers, you should handle this alone tonight
We'll be right back.
Every time you brace for space
Each transgression simply highlights
You forgot my embrace
Stay with me
That's what obedience has been
Not proving you're enough, just locking you
Every trial is a chance to stop and look to me
Don't fight alone, no, stay with me
I see the moment pressure rises
When the old resolve kicks in
You start assembling your answers
Try not to need me then
But child, the way through every trial
Is never you alone outpacing fear
It was always us together
Step by step, right here What you call temptation's voice
Is calling for lonely strife But my spirit quiet in your heart
Says let me empower your life
Stay with me
That's what obedience has been
Not proving you're enough, just locking in
Every trial is a chance to stop and look to me
Don't fight alone, no, stay with me
The days ahead will test your footing
Not testing worth nor what I see
You won't survive by standing stronger
You'll endure by leaning on me
When the wait feels impossible
Human wisdom runs thin and small
Remember this before you wander
I have already carried it all
Stay with me
That's what obedience has been
Not proving you're enough, just locking in
Every trial is a chance to stop and look to me
Don't fight alone, no, stay with me
This is how you care
This is how you stand
Not alone, no, never alone
